verdict.rationale: Ashby's docs describe a unified recruiting record — MCP context spans candidates, applications, interviews, offers, notes, feedback, emails and referrals (ashby-docs-12), and native AI Notetaker attaches interview summaries/feedback to the candidate record (ashby-docs-15, ashby-docs-29), plus the platform is marketed as combining ATS/CRM/Sourcing/Analytics into one tool (ashby-docs-30). However, consent status specifically is not documented as a field in this unified record, and a community report describes a broken opt-out mechanism for AI processing consent, undermining confidence that consent tracking is a reliable, working part of the profile (ashby-comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a consent-status field in the candidate record, and independent confirmation that consent tracking works reliably alongside the other unified data.
